locked.binary: Not a text file, so it cannot be edited here.

status.files: Show or hide the file list

notice.deleted: {{path}} was deleted on disk. Your text is still here: copy it before you leave.
notice.diskChanged: {{path}} changed on disk while you were editing it. Your text has not been saved.
notice.restored: Unsaved changes from last time are back. Save them, or discard them.
notice.tracked: This skill is updated from {{source}}. An update asks before it replaces anything you change here.
notice.copies_one: This project also has this skill in {{agents}}.
notice.copies_other: This project also has this skill in {{agents}}.

conflict.title: {{path}} changed on disk
conflict.description: Something else changed this file after you opened it. Nothing has been saved yet. Pick which version to keep.
conflict.unreadable: The version on disk could not be read.

versions.title: Earlier versions
versions.hint: Every save keeps the version it replaces, on this computer only.
versions.failed: Could not load the earlier version.
versions.loaded: Loaded the version from {{when}}. Save to keep it, or press undo to go back.

saved.keptTitle_one: Saved. One agent kept its own copy
saved.keptTitle_other: Saved. {{count}} agents kept their own copies
saved.keptDescription_one: The copy in {{agents}} has changes of its own, so it was not replaced. Compare the two on the agent's page.
saved.keptDescription_other: The copies in {{agents}} have changes of their own, so they were not replaced. Compare them on each agent's page.
saved.skippedTitle_one: Saved. One copy was left as it was
saved.skippedTitle_other: Saved. {{count}} copies were left as they were
saved.skippedDescription_one: The copy in {{agents}} had changes of its own, so it did not get this edit.
saved.skippedDescription_other: The copies in {{agents}} had changes of their own, so they did not get this edit.

empty.title: Nothing to edit
empty.description: This skill has no text files that can be edited here.

missing.title: This skill is no longer here
missing.description: It was moved or removed while the editor was open, or the link is out of date.

skills.editedHint: You changed this skill in the app. An update asks before replacing your edits.
